caption: The drawing shows a quilt block design with a square composition. In the central portion of the design, there are three stylized red flowers with yellow centers and small green details, each attached to a curved, green stem with several green leaves decorated with blue and yellow floral patterns. The background behind the flowers is filled with interconnected, rounded shapes shaded in pale pink. Surrounding the central floral area on two sides are rows of triangle shapes in red with a yellow pattern, forming a sawtooth border. The outer edges of the design feature a border with sinuous green vines and leaves on a background shaded in soft pale pink. The quilt block is set against a plain, off-white background and is signed in the lower right corner with the name "C. Christofield."
title: Quilt (Corner Section)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
